name: MCP Guard
summary: MCP Guard (mcp-guard.ai) is a hosted service that judges a proposed AI-agent tool call before it runs and returns a verdict (allow / ask / block) plus nine calibrated risk scores, from one forward pass of a fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base classifier. It is reachable as a first-party MCP server (api.mcp-guard.ai/mcp; tools guard_check, guard_batch, usage) or a REST endpoint, and the agent itself consults it. It decides, it does not enforce: the caller must honor the verdict. Keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer on 2026-11-19. Vendor self-reports AUROC 0.855 on R-Judge; no third-party measure.

payments.notes: $0.20 per 1,000 checks (1 check = 1 credit = one tool call judged on nine questions). 1,000 free requests per workspace, one-time; failed calls free; credits don't expire. Packs $5/$25/$100 and plans $19/$99/$399 a month. Stripe (card); EU/UK 14-day withdrawal; credits non-refundable.

agentAccess.notes: Needs an API key (mcpg_live_...) from the dashboard, so an account. Keyless POST initialize to api.mcp-guard.ai/mcp returned HTTP 401, Bearer challenge realm MCP Guard, JSON-RPC -32001 missing_api_key, 2026-11-19. Key rides Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key. 1,000 free requests per new workspace.

jobs.summary: guard_check returns a pre-execution verdict (allow / ask / block) on a proposed tool call, so a risky action gets a decision before it runs. A model-based risk judgment, not a configured permission engine; advisory, so it decides but the caller must honor the verdict. Vendor docs; not measured.
